mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.5%, it triggers immediate market repricing of monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in private employment signals labor market tightening, which precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts relative to the previous quarter signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion instances when HOUST declines relative to GDPC1, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 104.0, it indicates manufacturing contraction, causing immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 104.0 instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals housing market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of RSAFS decline and HOUST rise fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past month signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO increase instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in the past month, it signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE > 4.5% instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
